official_title: TeleConsole: Design and Development of a Secure Telehealth Video Communication System Using LiveKit with AI Summarization and Flexible User Access Design

slides.subtitle: Panel questions and an evidence-grounded demo
slides.notes: Introduce the original official title without renaming it. This supplement helps three writers explain scope and demonstrate the workflow; it does not replace the full methodology/results defense. The manuscript remains 259 pages with unchanged objectives, survey figures and project expense amounts. The source checkpoint is 69f9c85. State the actual deployed commit used in the demonstration, separately from local source. Sources: docs/thesis-defense/panel-questions-and-answers.md; revision-manifest.json.

slides.title: Contribution and evidence boundaries
rows: An integrated consultation and access workflow
A draft that the clinician must review
Perceived quality and scoped engineering tests
slides.bottom: No measured maximum call load, clinical efficacy or security certification
slides.notes: Answer priority questions 1-7 before feature details. We did not invent WebRTC or a diagnostic model. The published survey describes the selected respondents and the evaluated build; later admin changes do not retroactively become survey results. A passing regression is narrower evidence than a real clinic acceptance trial. Source: docs/thesis-defense/panel-questions-and-answers.md, priority Q1-Q7.

slides.title: Account identity and administrator authority
rows: Staff access only, no clinical API permissions
Staff access in one clinic, no doctor access
slides.bottom: Account creation and staff permission are separate decisions
slides.notes: Use /admin/login for administration. Signup creates identity only. New Administrator grants write an admin role, not Doctor, and revocation does not restore a legacy doctor profile. Existing combined claims are blocked by clinical APIs. Proposed Firestore rules deny administrator clinical reads and room creation in local emulator cases but require separate deployment. Environment-only bootstrap owners still need an approved historical-claim migration for the direct Firestore boundary. Existing media credentials have their own lifecycle. Do not claim instant universal revocation. Sources: docs/access-control.md; lib/auth/role-administration.ts; app/api/admin/roles/route.ts; scripts/thesis/emulator-administrator-separation.mjs.

slides.title: Patient admission flow
slides.bottom: Valid invitation and verified identity have different roles
slides.notes: Explain the signed invitation, persisted state, room binding, expiry and use checks. A verified allowlisted identity may receive direct admission. Other accepted visitors wait for a clinician decision. A new waiting place is reserved transactionally; an existing visit reconnect or direct admission is not another waiting place. Admission then leads to visible preflight and Join. Sources: lib/invitations/validate-service.ts; invitation-use-reservation.ts; invitation-access-core.ts.

slides.title: Waiting, admitted, connected and completed
rows: Permission to enter has been granted
slides.bottom: The queue is a manual admission worklist, not medical triage
slides.notes: Oldest-first display does not enforce FIFO treatment. The doctor must review the correct current visit; stale commands conflict rather than acting on a newer visit. Waiting pages mount no hidden room. Do not equate the admitted count with attendance or treat a disconnect as proof of sufficient summary evidence. Sources: app/invite/[token]/page.tsx; lib/services/invitation-access/invitation-access-core.ts.

slides.title: Waiting limit and media capacity
slides.label: Default waiting target for one invitation
rows: Keeps existing visitors, blocks additional waiting places
slides.bottom: A queue rule and a provider allowance are not a measured call limit
slides.notes: For the demo, set the target to 2 and open separate synthetic visitor contexts. Show the third visitor refused, then raise to 3 and retry. Do not lower the target and claim the current count instantly shrinks. Do not admit several unrelated patients into one clinical room; the evaluated encounter is one doctor and one patient. Sources: app/api/invite/limit/route.ts; reservation policy; the waiting-limit questions.

slides.title: Local capacity evidence and its limits
table: Acceptability scores are a different measure
slides.bottom: Dated emulator evidence: 27 November 2026; not a production load trial
slides.notes: The historical 25 November audit reproduced an overshoot. The 27 November implementation counts capacity inside the transaction, and the dated emulator receipt reports the two cases shown. No new media benchmark or language accuracy dataset is implied. A transaction's contention/retry behavior must still be measured under the intended deployment workload. Source: docs/thesis-defense/evidence/queue-capacity-fix-2026-11-27/emulator-capacity.json.

slides.title: Administrator demo and failure recovery
rows: Refresh claims, then open clinic administration
slides.bottom: API ownership and clinic checks remain authoritative
slides.notes: Show the chosen role and server-confirmed result. An old ID token may not contain newly granted claims; Check access again explicitly refreshes. A screenshot saying Granted doctor does not establish an admin grant. Auth lookup outages now produce retryable errors rather than false deleted-account labels. No real account changes are part of the rehearsal; use approved synthetic identities. Firebase claims reference: https://firebase.google.com/docs/auth/admin/custom-claims .

slides.title: Filipino, Taglish and English summaries
rows: fil-PH or en-US for browser recognition
English output with uncertain source terms preserved
Sparse or garbled capture can be insufficient
Clinician checks the draft against the source
slides.bottom: No measured bilingual recognition or clinical translation accuracy
slides.notes: The setting configures browser speech recognition, not a promise that every browser supports accurate Taglish. Recognition and summarization are distinct failure points. Negation, duration, dose, names and medicines deserve explicit checking. Use synthetic bilingual scripts for future evaluation, record omissions/unsupported facts and involve a clinician plus bilingual reviewer. Sources: DoctorControlsPanel.tsx; useSpeechCapture.ts; summary-generator.ts buildPrompt; the language questions.

slides.title: Encounter, consent and retention lifecycle
rows: May create a new encounter, fresh consent
slides.bottom: One invitation may host several distinct encounter records
slides.notes: The last doctor leaving ends an encounter; invitation revocation is not the only completion event. Never merge records by reused room name. Fresh-entry transcription starts unchecked. Chat is history, not current clinical summary evidence. Missing evidence can yield a deterministic nonclinical record without AI. Firebase retention processes at most 200 summaries plus 200 schedule entries per run; Vercel retries summaries, not deletion. Other copies/backups are not fully purged; age is not a deletion receipt. Future attachments need a separate cleanup policy and storage reconciliation. Doctor-booked appointments are implemented but deployment-gated: planning creates no admission, encounter or evidence. The original survey did not evaluate them. Sources: functions/index.js; history-presentation.ts; docs/superpowers/specs/2026-11-27-doctor-booked-appointments-design.md.

slides.title: The answer to the CCTV capacity question
slides.lead: We must give units, scope, conditions and evidence
slides.bottom: Measure receiver quality, failures, database/API operations and provider usage
slides.notes: A provider's connection ceiling is not proof of a safe number of consultations. Measure delivered video resolution/fps, packet loss, jitter, RTT, recovery and evidence isolation. State device/network/duration and acceptance thresholds before running the trial. Run controlled staging, not uncontrolled production stress. The current media options include adaptive stream, dynacast and simulcast, but settings are not results. Sources: RoomShell.tsx; capacity-quality-costs-and-team-scripts.md; priority Q1.

slides.title: What the evidence establishes
rows: Perceived quality of the evaluated build
128 local cases with synthetic IO adapters
Six call sizes; seven appointment browser cases
Signed-in acceptance and real-device media trials
slides.bottom: Local checks do not establish production capacity or clinical accuracy
slides.notes: Source checkpoint 69f9c85 passed 128 local regressions, seven appointment browser cases, real local Firestore transaction cases, typecheck, lint and a production build. Separate call-layout checks covered 320,390,768,820,1024 and1280px with synthetic media. Local rules cases denied combined/admin identities and retained doctor ownership access. This is not real iPad/Safari media acceptance, production load or language accuracy. The root scope guard rejects unrelated user AGENTS.md content; the full security command passed in an isolated snapshot with tracked instructions. Do not attribute later maintenance to survey respondents. Sources: docs/testing/evidence/2026-11-27-appointments/; docs/testing/evidence/2026-11-27-clinical-separation/verification.json.

slides.title: Three-writer panel rehearsal
rows: Capacity units, AI/language limits and recovery
slides.bottom: Current rule, reason, specific evidence, limitation
slides.notes: Use the 97-question prioritized bank. All prior 81 topics remain, with a stable-id map and 16 additions. Ranking is preparation judgment, not measured panel frequency. Retention is priority20, encounter lifecycle24 and scheduling25. Scheduling is implemented but default-off pending production rules/indexes, existing-data and contact-retention review and signed-in staging acceptance. No reminders or self-booking. Explain Appointment versus Encounter without claiming FHIR interoperability or original survey evaluation. Keep a five-minute version on slides2,3,4,7,10 and11. Sources: PANEL-QA-LATEST.md; panel-question-number-map.md.

slides.title: A bounded demonstration sequence
steps: 1. Administrator entry and correctly scoped staff grant
2. Gated test only: book, reject overlap, reschedule, cancel
3. Waiting limit two; third refused; raise limit and retry
4. Manual admission or verified allowlist direct entry
5. One synthetic patient call with optional consented notes
6. Encounter evidence, AI draft and clinician review
slides.notes: Use separate synthetic browser profiles; a shared Firebase uid is one principal. Demonstrate appointments only in an explicitly enabled synthetic test environment after prerequisites; otherwise show labeled local evidence. A booking issues no invitation and grants no admission. The queue example is not a group clinical workflow. If network or AI fails, show the real unavailable state without pretending success. Freeze and confirm the demonstrated commit. Preserve the official title, 259 pages and expenses; private appendices must not enter the public repository. Sources: one-day-defense-guide.md; admin-entry-findings-and-claude-handoff.md.
